group.label: Page Speed Pages
group.comment: Pages the Page Speed reporter times each hour. Pin a page here for a stable comparison over time; otherwise the busiest category and first product are picked automatically. The URLs actually timed (and whether pinned or automatic) are included in each report.

field.label: Category Page
field.comment: Optional. A path on this store (e.g. women/tops.html) or a full URL on the same host. Leave empty to pick one automatically.

field.label: Product Page
field.comment: Optional. A path on this store (e.g. my-best-seller.html) or a full URL on the same host. Leave empty to pick one automatically.

field.label: Search Page
field.comment: Optional. A path on this store (e.g. catalogsearch/result/?q=shirt) or a full URL on the same host. Leave empty to pick one automatically.

field.label: Cart Page
field.comment: Optional. A path on this store (e.g. checkout/cart/) or a full URL on the same host. Leave empty to pick one automatically.
